objective: Owner-authorized new child-safe BUKLOD Children's Story World in isolated DEV: curated bilingual offline catalog, story reader, narration, comprehension and System Admin editorial content publishing.
productionBaselineEvidence: BUKLOD current staging integration baseline is 2e7dc3aa69d2362b7b360013ccaac9917c353e2b. The feature DEV PR #823 head ee2a15afc3cc367d4d6d08620b41cd4753b03c4d passes mandatory source gates. This isolated staging branch starts from existing staging integration; no production merge, production EAS update or DB write.
chosenApproach: Forward-port the exact 18 child-story DEV source blobs onto current 1.3.2 staging integration baseline, preserving all other files and prior workstream commits. Add staging-only EAS OTA trigger after source PR CI succeeds. Reuse installed Expo/Speech/SVG; no native package changes. Supabase editorial migration remains source-only to avoid modifying shared production backend during staging.
selectionRationale: Avoid native rebuild, paid media service, large video assets, new authentication system, user-generated child chats and bandwidth spikes. Preserve working app surfaces, ads and production database.
alternativeApproaches: Video-based storybook: rejected due bandwidth and performance burden.
AI generated chat with children: rejected due safety, privacy and cost.
Standalone native children's application: rejected due duplicate build and account systems.
preserveBehaviors: The existing Home personal-household and Health Center doors keep their routes and styling.
Existing BUKLOD Wall, Connect, ads, profile, rank, Kingdom, quizzes, PTT and account roles remain unchanged except the scoped child-sensitive ad path exemption.
Generic ads remain enabled on all original eligible app pages and disabled only inside children-stories.
No child accounts, messaging, user-posted content, advertisements or QMP/financial rewards are added.
No native packages or Expo runtime change. Production/staging OTA and live database remain untouched until release gates.
acceptanceChecks: Twelve unique offline original bilingual stories, four categories and three age bands.
Home card, offline feature search and routes open to a reader with narration, page progression, quiz, favorites and adult-account scoped persistence.
Read-to-me narration stops on route exit, background and page/language changes.
Remote editorial content appears only after published approval and optional date cutoff; saved cached stories remain scoped to the adult account.
CMS requires AdminGate plus backend RLS enforcing system admin writes; published reads are constrained.
Story section sensitive prefix blocks generic ads while preserving ad behavior elsewhere.
Focused contract and catalog tests, SQL RLS contract, TypeScript build and staging behavior verification required before OTA.
No production release or live migration authorized in this feature DEV PR.
Staging EAS channel staging-user, Android org.mzbministry.buklod.staging, runtime 1.3.2, exact source SHA, no production mutation; physical device QA skipped by owner.
